Monitoring Report
Project name: Delta Mangrove Restoration
Applied methodology: ACM0010 Version 03.0

Reporting period: 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025.
The monitoring plan describes field sampling procedures and data review steps.
Project location: Delta Province, Coastal District.
The mapped project area is shown in the boundary map and mapped project area annex.
Monitoring records summarize monitored activity data and GHG reductions for the reporting period.
